claim: This artifact only tests deterministic risk ordering and counterfactual fallback cost/coverage. It supports no broad Halo quality or deployable-controller claim.

cost_accounting.wall_time_interpretation: sum of recorded compressed execution (chunk 128) and prior same-prompt B0 full-cache execution (chunk 256); not schedule-matched or a contemporaneous latency benchmark

feature_contract.query_delta_source: adjacent cumulative S difference aligned by semantic entry_id; the source run scored only temporary query probes

inferential_limit: The same 11 B0-selected clusters supply risk scores and outcomes. This is resubstitution-only mechanism evidence, not held-out controller validation.
selection_bias: Only 11 clusters already selected because Halo B0 was correct are included.
R2 benchmark-family cases are absent because the B0 capability gate was 0/8.
At most four clusters per included family and one evidence depth are represented.
The same 11 clusters describe risk association and threshold curves; there is no held-out calibration split.
Every threshold is shown and none is selected as a deployment operating point.
Full-cache outcomes and costs are reused from a same-prompt prior run whose full-cache prefill chunk is 256 rather than the compressed path's 128.
Each selected cluster contributes one case, so whole-cluster gating is enforced but numerically identical to case-level gating here.
